contentText: US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met in Florida on December 29 to discuss the next phase of the Gaza plan and Iran. At a press conference later, Donald Trump said Hamas had to disarm and claimed that Netanyahu was on his way to be pardoned for fraud, while expressing several views that challenge Netanyahu's. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us what to know, from Jerusalem.
